=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:61 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Changing `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES` from `false` to `true` breaks backward compatibility for consumer repos without `.ai/validate.yml`.
  WHY: Consumer repos that don't have `.ai/validate.yml` will get `harness_error` when validation runs instead of falling back to freehand generation, which was removed.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2160-2169 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The error message doesn't provide concrete guidance for repos without manifests.
  WHY: Users see "Freehand harness generation has been removed. Set VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=true..." but don't know what a manifest is or how to create one.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2160-2169 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No fallback or helpful guidance is provided for consumer repos without manifests.
  WHY: New consumer repos trying to use validation will hit a hard failure without a clear migration path.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:520-531 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Python dependencies are installed even when template mode is disabled or unavailable.
  WHY: Repositories with `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` pay the `pip install` cost before the job fails with `harness_error`.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2263-2269 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Exit code 14 is reused for two distinct failure scenarios: Python 3.9+ unavailability and renderer script failure.
  WHY: Troubleshooting can't distinguish environment issues from template render failures.

- .github/workflows/validate.yml:520-531 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow installs Python dependencies whenever `scripts/render_validation_templates.py` exists, regardless of whether template mode is enabled.
  WHY: This wastes CI time for repos that explicitly set `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false`.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2263-2269 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Exit code 14 combines two distinct failure scenarios: `python3 >= 3.9` is unavailable, or the renderer script failed.
  WHY: User cannot determine whether failure is due to missing Python version or renderer script error.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2160-2169 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES` is not "true", the error message says "Freehand harness generation has been removed" but doesn't link to documentation or example manifests to help users create `.ai/validate.yml`.
  WHY: Users hitting this error don't know how to create the required manifest.
